ecole.name: L'école : la salle de classe · School: the Classroom
ecole.alt: The village classroom painted in ink and gouache: the teacher reads standing on a blue mattress, a crayfish holds chalk, a sun in glasses gives a lesson at an easel, Monsieur Verbe listens to a white dove, reads with a prawn and bursts through a finish ribbon, a chalkboard on its own table, a goldfish pinning a card to the notice board, a globe with blue jelly, a young doe with a sack on her back and an exercise book folded into a kayak; an open door on the left leads to the playground, a half-open wooden door at the back shows the red curtains of the school theatre and a teal door on the right leads to the maths classroom.

doors.label: La classe de maths
doors.hint: Through the teal door to the maths classroom

doors.label: Le théâtre de l'école
doors.hint: Through the half-open wooden door to the school theatre

zooms.label: la trousse
zooms.hint: Open the pencil case on the desk

items.scene: The fat blue pencil case on the desk waves its little white flag of TRUCE.
Monsieur Verbe (red beret) leans out of the window, a hand cupped by his ear, listening to the white dove.

trousse.name: La trousse · Pencil Case
trousse.alt: Close-up of the desk with the open blue pencil case: a ruler with a crown and red cape, a collie puppy with its paw stuck to a glue bottle, a pink eraser in a silver gum wrapper, a pencil in a rainbow crayon wrapper and scissors riding a tiny wooden seesaw.

maths.name: La classe de maths · Maths Class
maths.alt: The maths classroom painted in ink and gouache: a pyramid peering through a spyglass, a star wrapped in a towel, a ball in a blue bowl on a stool, a red arrow in a target with a lightning flash, Monsieur Verbe adding a giraffe to a toy zoo, dividing a pizza in goggles and flippers and measuring a tall sunflower, the teacher's desk in front, an orange hoop, a musical triangle, a smiling ice cube, a big abacus with a toy bull on top and a blue square driving a red toy car; the open door on the left leads back to the classroom and the open garden door at the back leads out to the playground.

doors.label: L'école
doors.hint: Back through the door to the classroom

doors.label: La cour de récré
doors.hint: Go out through the garden door to the playground

zooms.label: le pupitre
zooms.hint: Look at what is on the teacher's desk

pupitre.name: Le pupitre · Desk
pupitre.alt: Close-up of the teacher's desk in the maths classroom: a purple line leaning on a little tightrope, half an orange in a bow tie, a slate with a sum drawn in chalk dots, a compass drawing a circle, a die in sunglasses holding up the sun and a golden sheaf of wheat with a tag of counting marks.

recre.name: La cour de récré · Playground
recre.alt: The sunny school playground painted in ink and gouache: twins in yellow dresses shrugging, a girl juggling six balls by a red see-saw, a farmer boy carrying eight sheaves of wheat on a pole (four on each side), a van with twenty crates in five rows of four, a tennis girl with seven balls in a row by her tipped-over basket, a toy boat sunk in a pond with five ducks, a mother cat with three kittens, a boy throwing three beanbags at a hoop, a boy pushing away a stack of nine pancakes, a girl holding up ten fingers, and in the bottom-left corner a little school fair with two striped stalls, a tombola wheel and a family walking up; the green door on the left leads back to the maths class.

doors.label: La classe de maths
doors.hint: Back through the green door to the maths class

zooms.label: la kermesse
zooms.hint: Walk over to the school fair

kermesse.name: La kermesse · School Fair
kermesse.alt: The school fair painted in ink and gouache: families stroll between three striped stalls; an empty nest sits on the blue book stall roof, which holds nineteen books (ten above, nine below); a plush cat with a lit torch sits on the red sweets stall roof, with eighteen wrapped sweets in three rows of six beside an empty jar; the orange stall has a big oozing cheese and twelve slices; in front are a pyramid of fifteen cans, a tray of fifteen dice with two more stacked on top, and thirteen trays standing in a row; at the front a table-football game with eleven little players, a green parrot on its perch, a tombola wheel, a girl running with a windmill and spilled popcorn; the green door on the left leads back to the playground.

doors.label: La cour de récré
doors.hint: Back through the green door to the playground

theatre.name: Le théâtre de l'école · School Theatre
theatre.alt: The school theatre painted in ink and gouache: under bunting and spotlights a little diva in pink sings la-la-la, a boy lugs a big sack over his shoulder, a girl in a grass skirt wears many flower leis and a striped strongman lifts a huge iron weight; in front of the stage a child dressed as the Wizard of Oz in a green robe points to a row of little painted doors, a mime holds up one finger, a girl in pink holds up one giant wooden spoon and a boy hugs his teddy; a model village with a river, boats and a cathedral sits on a table on the left, rows of chairs face the stage, costumes hang on a rail and the open door on the right leads back to the classroom.

doors.label: L'école
doors.hint: Back through the open door to the classroom

zooms.label: la maquette
zooms.hint: Look closely at the model village on the table

maquette.name: La maquette · The Model Village
maquette.alt: Close-up of the model village on the theatre table: two boys hold up their shiny fishing lures, a boy pushes his toy sailing ship along the river, a rowing boat waits with its oar, a little girl points at the model cathedral, a girl holds a bunch of daisies and a boy catches dew drops from a big leaf in his cup; tiny houses, a bridge, a street lamp and trees all around.
